effective_en_us.quest.courier_roads.wax_sealed_route.des: Prepare the paper, leather, and wax a village courier needs before messages can travel safely.

effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Bring 16 end stone so the lesson has something solid under it.
quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Proof is heavy in stranger ways than stone.
Bring 16 end stone now that the dragon is defeated; the bottled breath is already accounted for.
The proof can wait until the dragon has fallen.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Bring 16 end stone to complete the proof.
quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: You are here. That is the first proof. The rest can go on the table.
The final note says this: the world can be vast, cruel, and still return someone home. The village will remember that without making it smaller.
The Last Ember still needs its proof.
Bring the dragon breath and end stone here before we finish the notes.
I cannot close the Last Ember right now.
The last page waits. It has earned patience.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.breath_after_the_roar.s: Return with the Last Ember proof.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.descrip: Prepare the Last Ember notes for the gate by gathering eyes and the courage to face what answers them.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: The pearls and fire point toward a door that does not care whether anyone is ready.
Bring eyes of ender, and proof you can meet the staring dark. The village needs the lesson before the gate, not after.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: I will prepare for the gate.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: Defeat endermen and bring eyes of ender. The gate should not be the first time your hands shake.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: Bring 3 eyes of ender for the gate notes.
The staring dark has been answered.
Defeat 3 endermen without letting fear write the lesson for you.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: That is allowed. A gate does not become kinder because you hurry toward it.
Look away when you must. Courage is not staring until you break.
Defeat 3 endermen and bring 3 eyes of ender for the gate lesson.
The gate lesson is not open right now.
The gate notes are already steady.
Defeat 3 endermen and bring 3 eyes of ender. We are not opening anything today; we are learning how not to panic tomorrow.
The gate lesson is not ready right now.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.a: Defeat 3 endermen and bring 3 eyes of ender.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.r: The notes are ready to wait for the gate. That may be the hardest part.
Good. The third note says this: a door is not destiny until someone walks through it.
The gate lesson is still missing something.
Bring the gate materials here before we seal the notes.
I cannot close the gate lesson right now.
The notes remain open, which is another way of saying vulnerable.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.r: Return with the sealed gate materials.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.s: The eyes are enough to point. Bring an ender chest so the notes can wait without whispering from an ordinary drawer.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.s: Bring 1 ender chest to keep the Last Ember notes sealed.
quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.stage.s: Some notes deserve a lid that knows how to stay shut.
Bring 1 ender chest to seal the Last Ember notes.
The steady-hands lesson can wait until the eyes are ready.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.eye_before_dawn.title: Before Dawn
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.descripti: Carry the Last Ember study into Nether materials and learn which fires deserve respect.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bot: The rods prove the fire. Now bring powder and glowstone dust so the lesson can be held without burning the page.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bot: Bring 4 blaze powder for controlled flame.
Bring 8 glowstone dust so the lesson keeps its light.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bot: Powder in a bottle is still fire with patience.
Bring 4 blaze powder and 8 glowstone dust for the Nether candle.
The bottled flame can wait until the blaze work is done.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bot: Bring 4 blaze powder and 8 glowstone dust.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bri: Pearls taught us the shape of looking away. Fire teaches something less polite.
Bring blaze rods, and proof you faced the thing that made them. After that, we bottle the lesson carefully.
Defeat blazes and bring rods. The lesson needs heat that was earned, not stolen from a chest.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bri: Bring 2 blaze rods as heat that can be counted.
The blaze threat has been measured.
Defeat 3 blazes for the Nether candle study.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bri: Good. Nether work should never begin because someone felt hurried.
Come back with your eyebrows, if you can.
Defeat 3 blazes and bring 2 blaze rods for the Nether candle.
The Nether candle lesson is not open right now.
The Nether candle has already been written.
Defeat 3 blazes and bring 2 blaze rods. Respect the fire, but do not flatter it.
The Nether candle lesson is not ready right now.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.bri: Defeat 3 blazes and bring 2 blaze rods.
quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.ret: This is flame that can be named. Dangerous, but named.
Good. The second note says this: some fires guide, some fires consume, and wisdom starts by knowing the difference.
The Nether candle lesson is still missing something.
Bring the Nether materials here before we seal the lesson.
I cannot close the Nether candle right now.
Keep the powder sealed. Lessons are better when they do not escape.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.stage.ret: Return with the Nether candle materials.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.nether_candle.title: The Nether Candle
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.pearl_lessons.descripti: Begin the Last Ember line by studying ender pearls without treating fear as wisdom.
quest.last_ember.pearl_lessons.stage.ret: Pearls and paper. A small start, but every last road begins with a first note.
Good. The first note says this: fear is information, not a master.
The lesson still needs its pearls and book.
Bring the materials here before we write anything down.
I cannot close the pearl lesson right now.
The page stays open. Do not let it stare back too long.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.pearl_lessons.stage.ret: Return with the pearl study materials.
quest.last_ember.pearl_lessons.stage.stu: Some things make villagers lower their voices because old fear taught them manners.
Ender pearls are like that. Bring two, and a book. We will study what frightens us without bowing to it.
Bring 2 ender pearls and a book. We are making notes, not omens.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.pearl_lessons.stage.stu: Bring 1 book to keep the first notes.
quest.last_ember.pearl_lessons.stage.stu: Good. A lesson about fear should not begin with a dare.
Do not throw the pearls unless you are prepared to explain your landing.
Bring 2 ender pearls and 1 book for the first Last Ember lesson.
The pearl lesson is not counting right now.
The first pearl lesson is already written down.
Bring 2 ender pearls and 1 book. Keep your eyes steady if the pearls make the room feel watched.
This lesson is not ready to open right now.
effective_en_us.quest.last_ember.pearl_lessons.title: Pearls

lines: Survey an End City to test whether an Ancient City record describes the same builders.

lines: End City Survey

Bring a Shulker Shell and 1 Chorus Flower.
Return to the quest giver with proof from the End City.
End City Survey

Recovered {objective_item}.
Recover {objective_item} as proof of the journey.

quest.lost_civilization.tales_of_a_lost_: About the old city? I can mark the road again, or fold the map if you are done carrying it.
The map is still yours to follow. Ask for the mark again, or I can put the route away.
You came back carrying the quiet with you. Tell me you stood in the center, not just the shadow of the place.
That look is not from a cave. That is from somewhere older. Did you bring proof?
Good. A folded map remembers less than a carried one.
Then keep the mark. Some stories punish hesitation, but this one rewards care.
Folding this map means the trail goes cold for a while. Are you sure?
I can put the old mark away, but I will not pretend the place stops waiting.
Then I will fold the route away. If the old city keeps calling, come back and we can mark it again.
Done. The map rests for now.
Then I will fold the route away for a day. Give the ink time to dry before asking me to mark it again.
Done. I can revisit the mark later, once the map has settled.
Then I will close the ledger on this one.
Done. I will not offer that trail again.
That map is not in your hands right now.
There is no active trail here for me to fold away.
Then keep the map close until the road starts speaking again.
Fair. Some maps are better carried quietly.
So the stories were not just ink after all. Keep what you learned close, and let the village know you walked where silence keeps records.
You found the center and brought proof. That is more than a map can do. This village will remember your name beside that lost place.
An Echo Shard from the heart of {target}. I believe you. Some stories should be paid for before they are repeated.
You saw the place, then. Bring me {proof_item}, and I can call the tale complete.
The journey needs a token. Find {proof_item} in those depths and bring it back.
That shard alone is not enough. You need to stand in the central heart of {target}, not only its halls.

This needs a careful hand. This job is waiting through quiet and fighting through the alarm.
Take the task only if you are ready. Keep watch close to home, then answer any real threat.
Take this seriously. I am asking you to stand with the patrol, not roam alone.

Listen closely. A defense begins before the enemy is at the door.

Listen closely. When peace breaks, put yourself between danger and the doors.

Now I can close the ledger. You stood when it mattered. The watch will remember that.
The hard part is behind us. The gates held because people like you stayed.
The village can use this. I saw you answer the alarm without hesitation.
This will make a real difference. The villagers are safe, and your part in that is clear.
You saw it through. You kept the fighting away from the homes.

You saw it through. The patrol log will remember your name.
